// 04. sql replication

Every Dashboard Also in SQL

Every Power BI dashboard and Excel report in this portfolio is also written as SQL queries — proving I understand the data itself, not just the visualisation tool.

These queries produce identical results to the Power BI KPI cards and charts shown above.

✅KPI Cards → SQL aggregation queries
✅Bar Charts → GROUP BY + ORDER BY
✅Line Charts → date-series SELECTs
✅Scatter Charts → multi-column joins
✅Dashboard slicers → WHERE / HAVING
tsa_logistics.sql
-- TSA LOGISTICS: Power BI Dashboard SQL Replication

-- 1. FINANCIAL KPI CARDS (matches all 6 KPI cards)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(l.revenue + l.fuel_surcharge
          + l.accessorial_charges), 2)     AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(l.total_operating_cost), 2)  AS total_cost,
    ROUND(SUM(l.gross_profit), 2)           AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(AVG(l.gross_profit_margin_pct), 2) AS profit_margin,
    ROUND(AVG(l.revenue_per_mile), 4)       AS rev_per_mile,
    ROUND(AVG(l.cost_per_mile), 4)          AS cost_per_mile
FROM Loads l;

-- 2. DRIVER PAY vs LOAD REVENUE (combo chart)
SELECT
    d.full_name,
    ROUND(d.total_gross_driver_pay, 2)    AS gross_driver_pay,
    ROUND(d.total_revenue_by_driver, 2)  AS total_load_revenue
FROM  Drivers d
WHERE d.total_gross_driver_pay > 0
ORDER BY total_load_revenue DESC;

-- 3. MONTHLY REVENUE BY YEAR (line chart)
SELECT
    load_year, load_month,
    ROUND(SUM(total_load_revenue), 2)   AS monthly_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(total_operating_cost), 2) AS monthly_cost
FROM  Loads
GROUP BY load_year, load_month
ORDER BY load_year, MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(load_month, '%b'));

-- 4. REVENUE BY ROUTE — top 15 lanes
SELECT
    r.route_label,
    ROUND(SUM(l.total_load_revenue), 2) AS revenue_by_route,
    COUNT(*)                             AS total_loads
FROM  Loads  l
JOIN  Routes r ON l.route_id = r.route_id
GROUP BY r.route_label
ORDER BY revenue_by_route DESC LIMIT 15;

-- 5. MAINTENANCE COST BY TRUCK — top 10
SELECT
    m.truck_id, t.make,
    ROUND(SUM(m.maintenance_cost), 2) AS total_maint_cost,
    COUNT(*) AS events
FROM  Maintenance_Records m
JOIN  Trucks t ON m.truck_id = t.truck_id
GROUP BY m.truck_id, t.make
ORDER BY total_maint_cost DESC LIMIT 10;
-- SALES ANALYSIS: SQL Replication

-- 1. OVERALL KPIs (matches 3 KPI cards)
SELECT
    SUM(unit_price * quantity)              AS total_revenue,
    SUM(cost_price * quantity)              AS total_cogs,
    SUM((unit_price - cost_price) * quantity) AS total_profit
FROM sales_data;

-- 2. PRODUCT BY PROFIT (bar chart — most profitable)
SELECT
    product,
    SUM((unit_price - cost_price) * quantity) AS total_profit,
    SUM(unit_price * quantity)               AS total_revenue
FROM  sales_data
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY total_profit DESC;
-- Laptop A13 leads: ₦105.3M profit

-- 3. SALES REP BY REVENUE (bar chart)
SELECT
    sales_rep,
    SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*)                    AS total_orders
FROM  sales_data
GROUP BY sales_rep
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
-- Peter leads: ₦434.8M

-- 4. MONTHLY REVENUE — worst month
SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m')   AS month,
    SUM(unit_price * quantity)   AS monthly_revenue
FROM  sales_data
GROUP BY month ORDER BY monthly_revenue ASC;
-- HR EMPLOYEE ANALYSIS: SQL Replication

-- 1. SECTION A — Basic Aggregations
SELECT
    SUM(salary)             AS total_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2)  AS avg_salary,
    COUNT(*)               AS total_employees,
    MAX(salary)            AS max_salary
FROM employees;

-- 2. SUMIF — Sales dept total salary: ₦6,081,869
SELECT SUM(salary) AS sales_salary
FROM  employees WHERE department = 'Sales';

-- 3. AVERAGEIF — HR dept avg: ₦353,549
SELECT ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS hr_avg
FROM  employees WHERE department = 'HR';

-- 4. SUMIFS — Lagos + experience > 3 yrs: ₦5,470,326
SELECT SUM(salary) AS lagos_senior
FROM  employees
WHERE city = 'Lagos' AND experience_years > 3;

-- 5. COUNTIFS — Male in Lagos: 15
SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_lagos
FROM  employees
WHERE gender = 'Male' AND city = 'Lagos';

-- 6. TEXT FUNCTIONS — split name + email
SELECT
    full_name,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(full_name, ' ', 1)   AS first_name,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(full_name, ' ', -1)  AS last_name,
    LOWER(CONCAT(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(full_name,' ',1), '.',
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(full_name,' ',-1),
        '@dame.com'
    )) AS email
FROM employees;
-- ECOMMERCE DASHBOARD: SQL Replication

-- 1. KPI CARDS (Revenue, Cost, Profit, Customers)
SELECT
    SUM(s.SalesAmount)                AS total_revenue,
    SUM(s.UnitCost)                   AS total_cost,
    SUM(s.SalesAmount - s.UnitCost)   AS total_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.CustomerID)      AS total_customers
FROM Sales s;

-- 2. PROFIT BY BRAND (bar chart)
SELECT
    p.Brand,
    SUM(s.SalesAmount - s.UnitCost) AS total_profit
FROM  Sales    s
JOIN  Products p ON s.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.Brand
ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

-- 3. QUANTITY BY COLOR (donut) — most sold color
SELECT
    p.Color,
    SUM(s.Quantity) AS total_qty,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Quantity) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM Sales), 1) AS pct
FROM  Sales    s
JOIN  Products p ON s.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.Color ORDER BY total_qty DESC;

-- 4. PROFIT BY INCOME LEVEL
SELECT
    c.IncomeLevel,
    SUM(s.SalesAmount - s.UnitCost) AS profit
FROM  Sales     s
JOIN  Customers c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.IncomeLevel
ORDER BY profit DESC;
-- Medium: ₦115K · High: ₦101K · Low: ₦95K
